Modifies the existing business hours for the specified location.
Send this request [GET /locations/{locationId}/businesshours](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/AfterHours/GETv3_locations__locationId__businesshours) to get the location business hours.
Learn [how to manage business hours](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/683409418/Managing+Business+Hours+and+Holidays+for+a+Location) in ServiceChannel University.
**Example Request** POST / locations/{locationId}/businesshours { "businessHours": [ { "DayOfWeek": "Monday", "OpenTime": "10:15 AM", "CloseTime": "06:00 PM", "ClosedAllDay": false } }

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to change business hours for.

response.name: Business hours are updated for the specified location.

618 — Open Time or Close Time cannot be empty for a specific day of the week
628 — Incorrect format of the `Close All Day` value. Valid values: true, false.

Adds a holiday to the specified location.
Send this request [GET /locations/{locationId}/holidays](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/AfterHours/GETv3_locations__locationId__holidays) to get the location holidays.
Learn [how to manage holidays for a location](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/683409418/Managing+Business+Hours+and+Holidays+for+a+Location) in ServiceChannel University.
**Example Request** POST /locations/{locationId}/holidays { "HolidayName": "Happy Weekend", "OpenTime": "10:00 AM", "CloseTime": "06:00 PM", "ClosedAllDay": false, "Frequency": "Yearly", "StartDate": "2021-07-03T00:10:00.308Z", "RepeatEvery": "1", "RepeatBy": "DayOfWeek", "RepeatOnDays": [ "Saturday", "Sunday" ], "RepeatOnMonths": [ “June”, "July", "August" ] }

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to add or update holidays for.

response.name: The holiday is added to the specified location.

620 — List of days cannot be empty when submitting the `Weekly` frequency
621 — List of months cannot be empty when submitting the `Yearly` frequency
622 — Incorrect month format. Valid values: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.

624 — Incorrect format of the 'Repeat every' value. The value should be a number between 1 and 60.
625 — The same month is specified twice in the 'Month' value
626 — Incorrect format of the frequency. Valid values: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Singular.
627 — Start date cannot be an empty value
628 — Incorrect format of the `Close All Day` value. Valid values: true, false.
3502 — The holiday name is already in use. Please suggest another name.
